import pandas as pd

def create_matrix(input_file, output_file):
    # Load the input data
    data = pd.read_csv(input_file)

    # Pivot the data into a city-year by indicator matrix
    matrix = pd.pivot_table(data, values='value', index=['city_id', 'year'], columns='indicator_id')

    # Reset the index to include the city_id and year as columns
    matrix = matrix.reset_index()

    # Rename the columns to match the required output format
    matrix = matrix.rename(columns={'city_id': 'city_id', 'year': 'year'})

    # Fill any missing values with an empty string
    matrix = matrix.fillna('')

    # Write the matrix to the output file
    matrix.to_csv(output_file, index=False)

create_matrix('outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv', 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')
